decoder.name: Phoneme beam -> CMUdict word decoder (Fidetype)
decoder.weights_licence: no trained weights (input: published RNN logits, CC0; CMUdict BSD-style; Tatoeba CC BY 2.0 FR)

policy.name: trust gate + LTT
policy.description: commit threshold by Learn then Test, alpha 0.05, delta 0.1

cer.basis: aggregate of the committed run (no per-trial CER)

shuffled.basis: aggregate null audit of the top-1 decoder (n=300): wrong-commit real 0.637 vs frame-shuffled 1.000

zeros.basis: aggregate null audit (uniform logits stand in for zeros input, n=300): wrong-commit real 0.637 vs uniform 1.000

null_commit.basis: P6-01 null audit at this entry's threshold (LTT lambda 0.5400), uniform logits stand in for zeros input, n=300; commits per null input: other_trial 50/300, frame_shuffled 0/300, uniform 0/300

guarantee.scope: marginal wrong-commit rate over test trials; assumes calibration and test trials are exchangeable; the bound covers the pool (all days of one participant together), not each day: one day can be worse (trust guarantee section 4: https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/docs/trust-guarantee.md#4-what-is-not-guaranteed)

conformance.checked: adapter streams (fidetype.adapters.b2t25), all 816 test files of the stream submission

notes: cal = first half of each day, test = second half: the test trials are later in the day, so cal and test are not exchangeable (drift; see M2-13/M2-16).

2026-11-25: the scope line now says that the bound covers the pool of all days of one participant, not each day (trust guarantee section 4). Basis: the pooled-guard check (commit 74a21f8; https://github.com/zhangzibo/fidetype/blob/main/experiments/2026-11-25-pooled-guard-check/results.md). No number changed.

correction_rule.formula: 2 s + 0.7895 s/char * len(truth) per wrong commit
correction_rule.prefix: a wrong prefix of k words costs the penalty of the first k words of the truth

reading_cost.formula: 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word * k per commit (right or wrong); prefix commits with fewer than 1 word(s) count as no commit
reading_cost.note: the adopted safe-wpm/0.2 reading cost (2026-11-22) is 0.5 s + 0.3 s/word per commit, minimum prefix 1 word; other values give a sensitivity variant
